_comment: T2/F13#5 swimming-current arrow. ON by default per UX.md line 322 after the Medium/High code-blind review (GPU G-newapproach-t2-cue, 10 Nov, LANE-NEWAPPROACH/LANE-SCOUT, three judges, confirming batch: High +0.60, Medium +0.81, 3/3; blind direction test 18/18 at confidence 9 vs about half guessed without it). Players can turn it off in Accessibility (device-local preference). Process-local --tidewake-current-candidate still forces it on. Device accessibility setting never changes swimming, gear, current strength, world flags or peers.
label: Current

strength_marks._why_on: LANE-SCOUT G-newapproach-t2-bars (10 Nov, HUD-only change judged on CPU frames, three code-blind judges with anchors): one to three bars behind the arrow show how hard the current pushes; 6.59 -> 7.16 (+0.57, 3/3). The T2 judges had said strength had no cue.
